Hi Renato, it's Dana. I know you're in your tent now, and I know you're nervous. That's normal. Listen. You've had such a good month. Your fitness is so much better, and your strategy is clear. Tonight, don't watch videos and don't read the comments. Have an early night. Before you sleep, close your eyes and visualize your first wave: you paddle, you stand up, you take the drop. Set your alarm for five thirty. Your heat is at eight, so we've got plenty of time. You're ready, mate. See you at the tent at seven.

Hey mate, it's Kai. I'm in the tent next to yours, but I don't want to wake Tom, so I'm sending a message. What a day! The drive was so long, but the scenery was amazing, and that sunset at the beach was so beautiful. Okay, the plan for tomorrow. Breakfast is at six, in the van. Jess is bringing bananas and toast. We leave the campsite at six forty, because the parking lot gets so crowded. And don't forget your jersey number. You're number four. Get some sleep!
